items.rationale: The fixed unit suffered lightning overvoltage under 2.3.3 and was nine metres from the hob, outside the five-metre exclusion in 2.3.10(c). Sections 7.1.9–7.1.10 limit the one-unit replacement to the gross cost of an equivalent 3.5 kW unit (€1,411), not the 7.1 kW upgrade.

Sections 7.1.9(c) and 7.1.11 cover the labour needed to install and commission an equivalent replacement, but not any extra labour attributable to the upgrade. One standard installation is estimated at €482 gross.

Section 7.1.10 excludes the whole console charge because it was chosen for appearance and was not needed to install the replacement. The €61 estimate is a conditional benchmark for one console, not a payable amount.
Sections 7.1.9(e) and 7.1.11–7.1.12 cover ordinary carriage for the equivalent replacement. One shipment is estimated at €42 gross, excluding the separately billed express surcharge.

Section 7.1.12 excludes timed or expedited surcharges unless agreed in advance or necessary to mitigate further loss; neither is established. The €50 estimate is conditional on coverage for the single surcharge.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separate contractor administration and paperwork fees in full. The €35 estimate is conditional on coverage for the single flat fee.
